Managing rentals for many owners means rent to chase, repairs to dispatch, statements to send and owners to keep happy — every month, across dozens of spreadsheets that never agree with each other.
This suite replaces them with six connected workbooks, one for each desk of a property management office — 354 pages in all, each specific to the job:
1. Rentals & Leasing — live rent roll, tenant ledger with arrears ageing, leases, renewals checked against your increase cap, deposits, applicant screening, viewings, notices and payment plans.

2. Maintenance & Operations — work orders with response targets, vendors and their ratings, preventive maintenance, inspections, assets and warranties, safety certificates, insurance, incidents and unit make-ready.

3. Owner Accounting & Statements — owner ledgers, management and leasing fees, payouts, reserves, budgets against actual, service charges and the monthly client-account reconciliation, with an owner statement ready to print.
4. Market Radar & Valuation — rent and sale comparables by district, rent per m² trends, days on market, new supply, demand, under-market units, rent reviews, acquisitions and valuations.
5. Short-Term & Holiday Rentals — bookings by channel, occupancy, average nightly rate, revenue per available night, seasons, cleaning turns, reviews, licences and owner payouts.
6. Management Office — new-owner leads and proposals, management contracts, team workload, tasks, company income and costs, marketing return and service quality.

Inside: 72 calculators (prorated rent, late fees, fair rent increases, affordability, repair or replace, owner payout, income valuation, mortgage and cash-on-cash, nightly pricing and more), 96 printable statements, letters and agreements filled from your records, 48 step-by-step checklists, 166 ready WhatsApp messages and 110 live charts with 178 dashboard figures.
Type in the white cells; everything grey calculates by itself. Each workbook comes with an English copy full of realistic sample data, so you can see every page working before you enter your own.

15 languages in one purchase: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese and Indonesian (Arabic, Persian and Urdu read right to left). Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice. No macros, no subscription, one payment, instant download. Licence for one business.

Do I need special software?
No. The files open in Microsoft Excel on Windows or Mac and in LibreOffice Calc, which is free.
Does it work for my country and currency?
Yes. Amounts have no currency symbol, and rules such as grace days, late fees, increase caps and fee percentages are your own settings.
Can I change the drop-down lists?
Yes. Every list lives on the Lists sheet; rename an item there and every page follows.
Is it a subscription?
No. One payment, instant download, and the files are yours to use in your business.
Where do I start?
Open the workbook in your language, fill the yellow cells on the Start sheet, then follow the How to use it steps.
Are there macros?
No macros and no add-ins: only formulas, so the files are safe to open.
